china-1916:p0485_1.rationale: Lists Roman Catholic mission stations by vicariate and mission body, with unlabelled numeric columns (apparently priests and converts, but headings unreadable). Statistical structure is established, so no text-tables flag.
review_questions: Column headings for the four numeric columns are unreadable; their exact meaning is uncertain.

china-1916:p0486_1.rationale: Catholic mission headquarters with foreign and native priests, baptized converts and applicants for baptism; quantitative religious-mission data.

china-1916:p0486_2.rationale: Summary counts of Catholic bishops and priests, foreign and native.

china-1916:p0486_3.rationale: Textual list of Catholic vicariates, mission societies and headquarters, with no quantities.

china-1916:p0486_4.rationale: Counts of Catholic vicariates, prefectures and other ecclesiastical units, with a note on converts.

china-1916:p0488_1.rationale: Protestant tract societies with circulation of copies and receipts; religious propagation through printed tracts.
review_questions: No vocabulary tag for religious tracts or religious publishing; propose one.

china-1916:p0488_2.rationale: Summary of Protestant mission staff, Chinese workers and stations for 1910-1912.

china-1916:p0489_1.rationale: Protestant mission schools and scholars plus Chinese Christian congregations and community size, 1910-1912.

china-1916:p0489_2.rationale: Mission hospitals, dispensaries and patient numbers with Chinese contributions, 1910-1912.

china-1916:p0520_1.rationale: Textual list of mining localities, districts and minerals (coal, iron, gold) in Fengtien and Kirin, with no quantities. Related to a Sino-Japanese agreement, but the table itself is a locality list.
review_questions: Which tag fits a locality list of mining sites? Propose a term; mineral-reserves was not assigned since no deposit estimates are given.
